sentences.text:
This is first application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail in relation to FIR No.157/2023 registered at Police Station Beena, District Sagar (M.P.)
for the offence under Sections 363, 366-A, 376(2)(n) of IPC and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that prosecutrix is a consenting party and she had crossed the age of 16 years and have sufficient maturity.
Applicant has not committed rape on prosecutrix.
In these circumstances, applicant be enlarged on bail.

sentences.text: 3. Learned Deputy Government Advocate appearing for State opposed the prayer for grant of bail.
It is submitted by him that prosecutrix is minor and her consent is immaterial.

In these circumstances,
application be dismissed.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5.

Considering the fact that prosecutrix has crossed the age of 16 years and it is an admitted fact that she was consenting party and considering her statement recorded under Section 161 of Cr.P.C., bail application filed by applicant is allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) along with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned.

7. The applicant shall abide by the conditions of Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
C.C. as per rules.
